candidates.title: Library volume point-in-time report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report that shows the count of items in a specified library at a specified point in time.
candidates.source_quote: how do I get a report that tells me how many items we have at Dalton-Whitman at any given moment?
candidates.priority_signals: We need this for our monthly board report; "This will be tracked as a key requirement."

candidates.title: Separate counts: new acquisitions
candidates.statement: The system shall report the count of new acquisitions (items recently added) for a specified library and date or date range.
candidates.source_quote: The volume should include: 1. New acquisitions (items recently added)
candidates.priority_signals: "This will be tracked as a key requirement."

candidates.title: Separate counts: items on shelf
candidates.statement: The system shall report the count of items on the shelf (checked in) for a specified library and date or point in time.
candidates.source_quote: The volume should include: 2. Items on the shelf (checked in)
candidates.priority_signals: "This will be tracked as a key requirement."

candidates.title: Separate counts: items out in circulation
candidates.statement: The system shall report the count of items out in circulation (checked out) for a specified library and date or point in time.
candidates.source_quote: The volume should include: 3. Items out in circulation (checked out)
candidates.priority_signals: "This will be tracked as a key requirement."

candidates.title: Total volume includes checked-out items
candidates.statement: The system shall include items that are checked out when calculating the total volume for a library (total counts include checked-out items).
candidates.source_quote: I assume items that are checked out still count toward your total volume, right?
candidates.priority_signals: Discussion point affecting design; included in summary as part of total based on checked in/out/new acquisitions.

candidates.title: Breakdown by listed categories
candidates.statement: The system shall allow breaking down volume into categories including total items, number of holds, number of adult fiction, number of board books, and other customizable categories.
candidates.source_quote: The report should allow breaking down volume in categories such as: - Total items - Number of holds - Number of adult fiction - Number of board books - Other customizable categories
candidates.stakeholder: Maria Rodriguez, Susan Sexton-Cooley, Katherine Gregory
candidates.priority_signals: "This will be tracked as a key requirement."; user examples requested for board report

candidates.title: Customizable categories per library
candidates.statement: The system shall allow each library to customize which categories are used to break down the volume report.
candidates.source_quote: Can we make the categories customizable? Different libraries might want different breakdowns.
candidates.priority_signals: Twin Lakes needs this for their quarterly assessment; summary explicitly lists "Other customizable categories."

candidates.title: Filter by library location
candidates.statement: The system shall allow specifying a library location filter so the report counts only items whose location equals the selected library.
candidates.source_quote: Counts all items with a location = your library
candidates.priority_signals: Summary: "in a given library at any point in time."

candidates.title: Group by category attributes
candidates.statement: The system shall group counts by category attributes such as fiction/non-fiction and format.
candidates.priority_signals: Requested for collection management and design considerations

candidates.title: Holds count per category
candidates.statement: The system shall show the number of holds per category in the volume breakdown.
candidates.source_quote: Shows breakdowns with holds count per category
candidates.priority_signals: Users explicitly requested holds in breakdown; appears in proposed query

candidates.title: Point-in-time and historical filtering
candidates.statement: The system shall allow filtering the report by a specific date or point in time to produce historical volume counts, not just current values.
candidates.source_quote: We can also add date filters - volume at any point in time, not just current.
candidates.priority_signals: "This will be tracked as a key requirement."; useful for historical comparisons

candidates.title: Report volume changes over time and recent additions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports of volume changes over time and support reporting how much volume was added in configurable recent intervals (e.g., last 30, 60, 90 days).
candidates.source_quote: It would be helpful to see how much volume has been added in the last 30/60/90 days.
candidates.priority_signals: Latoya requested for assessment; Robert: "We can definitely build reports that show volume changes over time."

candidates.title: Consolidated single-report output
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a consolidated material volume report that aggregates counts so users do not need to manually gather data from multiple screens.
candidates.source_quote: I'm currently pulling it manually from three different screens.
candidates.priority_signals: User currently does manual aggregation for monthly board report; request marked as a key requirement

candidates.title: Use acquisition date field for acquisition reports
candidates.statement: The system shall use the item acquisition date tracked in the database when generating acquisition-related and time-range volume reports.
candidates.source_quote: Yes, the database tracks acquisition date for items.
candidates.priority_signals: Enables reporting of additions over time and last 30/60/90 days
